description: Padatious × Adapt fusion — the intent-classifier stages of the stock OVOS pipeline in shipped order: Padatious high, Adapt high, then Adapt medium. First stage whose own confidence gate fires wins.
notes: HYPOTHESIS: does the stock OVOS default order — neural template (Padatious) first, keyword rules (Adapt) as fallback at two tiers — beat either engine alone? Template and keyword-rule matching are different paradigms (learned similarity vs explicit vocab/grammar), so the fusion tests real complementary coverage; mirrors the shipped mycroft.conf pipeline restricted to arena-supported engines (m2v stage omitted until it joins the roster).
